name: Caxium 58" UHD Smart TV
summary: Caxium 58" UHD Smart TV ships with ads, auto-installs and background services. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Caxium 58-inch TV uses the TopTech and Zeasn platform. It ships with content and ads that install apps by themselves, a telemetry and update check, background services nobody needs, unused preloaded apps and a voice assistant. The list has 9 apps.

The Netflix and YouTube apps, Chrome, the cast receiver and the USB media browser are kept. TidyTV turns the rest off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each app can be switched back on. faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Caxium TV?
faq.a: Not if you switch off the voice assistant, which is on the list. The mic button then stops working. Leave that one on if you use voice.
